name: rocky-marketplace
description: Marketplace serving rocky and its companion rocky-todo Claude Code plugins. rocky is this repo (source "./"); rocky-todo is served from its own repo (github source).

plugins.name: rocky
plugins.description: 7 openapi_* tools (cache-first OpenAPI / Swagger spec inspection, endpoint search, tag list) + seo_validate + notion_* (ntn CLI-gated) + worklog_* (append-only local JSONL worklog, auto turn capture via Stop hook). Slash commands: /rocky:finish, /rocky:recall, /rocky:codex, /rocky:opencode, /rocky:issue, /rocky:soul, /rocky:statusline.

plugins.name: rocky-todo
plugins.description: 공유 todo/스크래치패드 상주 데몬 + 웹 UI + streamable HTTP MCP(5 도구) + CLI. 설치=활성화(SessionStart 훅이 데몬 기동). rocky 동반 플러그인 — dependencies:["rocky"] 로 자동 동반. 별도 레포 minjun0219/rocky-todo 에서 서빙.
